reuse.why: All month-wide actions reuse the exclusion predicate, and the new action uses existing sheet, budget, batching, and undo abstractions.

duplication.why: The change consolidates repeated category queries and exclusions, but the new action repeats the income-versus-tracking eligibility guard.

placement.why: Selection policy and budget calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, with method registration and undo wrapping in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their supporting data, registration, test, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusion predicate makes future rule changes straightforward, although income eligibility remains distributed among individual actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth applies the shared predicate to budget rows, while the other month-wide actions use getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income eligibility guard is explicit; the exclusion logic is shared rather than reshaped into separate implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories is introduced on both getMonthWideCategories and isSkippedByMonthWideAction to support the requested variation; no action-specific exceptions or bypasses are introduced.
